name: 77422 · Brazoria, TX
findings: ZIP 77422 (Brazoria) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77422 (Brazoria) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77422 (Brazoria) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
